description.value: This study measured regional brain tissue volumes in active heavy drinkers and light drinkers and assessed associations with drinking severity and family history of problem drinking.

spans.text: The goals of this study were to measure if chronic active heavy drinking is associated with brain volume loss in non-treatment seeking men and women, and to assess the effect of positive family history of problem drinking on brain structure in heavy drinkers.

description.value: Observational, cross-sectional comparison of active heavy drinkers and light drinkers, with within-heavy-drinker regression and family-history comparisons.
